name: Bobbio (Italy)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bobbio (a red cross on white) within branches, with the inscription CITTÀ DI BOBBIO in yellow arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Bobbio, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Bobbio arms — red cross on white, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI BOBBIO arched above the arms
